description: Registry of authoritative sources for each Warehouse artifact family. Each entry names the single canonical location. Non-authoritative mirrors, reflections, and generated copies must not be treated as truth.
precedence_rules: versioned + schema-backed artifact supersedes unversioned descriptive artifact
explicit policy matrix supersedes adapter-local convenience docs
numbered taxonomy supersedes unnumbered taxonomy unless explicitly grandfathered
explicit accepted decision records supersede implied practice

artifact_families.name: authority-and-policy
artifact_families.notes: Explicit write-governance and authority rules found in recovered docs.

artifact_families.name: memory-taxonomy
artifact_families.notes: Numbered tree preferred. Legacy unnumbered tree still active; requires deprecation decision.

artifact_families.name: signal-lang
artifact_families.notes: Versioned fenced-YAML block format preferred. Legacy .signal front-matter still present.

artifact_families.name: agent-contracts
artifact_families.notes: Shared agent prompt files define behavioral constraints. Canonical for adapter-local copies.

artifact_families.name: lineage
artifact_families.notes: Lineage fields exist across many artifacts but no blessed standalone schema. Requires creation.

artifact_families.name: recovery-manifest
artifact_families.notes: Recovery instructions exist as prose only. Requires machine-readable schema.

artifact_families.name: warehouse-specification
artifact_families.notes: Provisional candidate spec. Not final canon. Subject to Bruce approval.

missing_artifacts: authority-map migration note — maps old paths to new canonical paths
